findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_kg_facts · Private data: get_token_research, get_token_intel, get_microburst, get_warnings, get_unanimous, get_stats, get_quartermaster, get_pair_gate, search_tokens, agent_connect, agent_contribute · Public sink: agent_contribute, get_kg_facts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_kg_facts · Private data: get_token_research, get_token_intel, get_microburst, get_warnings, get_unanimous, get_stats, get_quartermaster, get_pair_gate, search_tokens, agent_connect, agent_contribute · Public sink: agent_contribute, get_kg_facts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
